title: Contact Backup & Cleaner
summary: Convert contact to PDF, VCF & auto backup contacts & duplicate contact remover
description:
Contact Backup and Contact Cleaner app

 Ensure that every number, email, and contact detail is safely stored and easily retrievable whenever you need it.

The Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner app offers secure storage, easy recovery, and a powerful cleaner tool to streamline your address book.

Keep Your Contacts Safe with Easy Backup Options
Key Features of Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner
👤📲 Flexible Contact Backup Options
Save your contacts in PDF, VCF, or Text file formats to keep them safe in the best way for you. No more worrying about data loss! Contacts & backup can make switching devices and restoring contacts more accessible.

👤📲 Recover Contacts Effortlessly
You can quickly retrieve contacts from backups stored on your phone or other devices with the Recover Contacts tool. Whether setting up a new phone or restoring contacts after a reset, restoring contacts is just a tap away.

👤📲Automatic Duplicate Fix
Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner can automatically detect and merge duplicate contacts, giving you a cleaner, more organized contact list. No more sifting through multiple entries for the same person. Contact Cleaner app takes care of that for you.

👤📲Transfer Contacts Across Devices
Use my contacts backup to export contacts and restore them on your new device effortlessly. You can back up on one phone and restore on another, regardless of brand or OS.

👤📲Customizable Backup Formats
The contacts backup solution gives you flexibility, so your contacts are available whenever and wherever you need them.

Choose Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner!
🔄Easy Recovery and Restore
Fast recover contacts from your backups or restore them on a new device without hassle. You can access your entire contact list anytime and keep track of essential connections. The restore contacts feature is straightforward, making setup on a new phone smooth and efficient.

🔄User-Friendly Interface
Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner is designed with simplicity in mind. Every feature is easy to use, so you can manage, back up, and organize contacts without technical know-how.

🔄No Need for Internet Access
Don’t worry about connectivity! The contacts backup process works offline, meaning you can create a backup anytime, anywhere, without an internet connection.

🔄Auto Reminders for Backups
Stay protected with reminders that notify you to back up your contacts. This ensures you’ll always have the most recent contact list available.

The choice is yours, and with Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner, you’re equipped to protect and manage your contacts however you prefer.

Secure Your Contacts Today!
With Contact Backup & Contact Cleaner, every contact is secure and easily recoverable, giving you peace of mind and convenience. Download now and make your contacts backup experience easy and efficient. Ensure your essential connections are always a tap away with Contacts & Backup.
